propositions.proposition: CRM record HEL-441 corresponds to the account name Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent crm:HEL-441 to the name Helion Robotics Ltd used in CRM.

propositions.proposition: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM, while invoices use Helion Robotics Limited, and these are the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly links the CRM operating name (Helion Robotics Ltd) to the billing/legal name (Helion Robotics Limited) as one legal entity.

propositions.proposition: Invoices bill under the name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the billed name appearing on invoices.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics.
propositions.relevance: Establishes that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is distinct from Helion Robotics, but does not bear on whether crm:HEL-441 and billing:Helion Robotics Limited are the same entity.
